description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 For their take on this one off Liddesdale, Ganni has added some of their iconic and instantly recognisable features.  Elevated velvet bows from their Bow shirt replace Barbour studs and Ganni's signature frill collar has been oversized and created in corduroy to dramatic effect. title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 Paul Smith's inspiration has come from the 1990s in a nostalgic nod back to the very first introduction of the Liddesdale in 1994. On the front of the quilt is Paul Smith's iconic collegiate pattern with each of the years recorded from 1994 – 2024 representing 30 years of this iconic quilt.   The stitching came from a fabric 'letter' which Paul received from a friend providing the inspiration for the jacket to be embroidered for each year it has graduated, like a wearable yearbook. The inner lining is a reproduction of a striking archive Paul Smith 'Button Print' which dates back to Autumn Winter 93-94.  Paul Smith buttons replace Barbour studs in this outstanding homage to the Barbour Liddesdale. "Being able to create a unique piece for the 30th anniversary of Barbour's legendary Liddesdale Jacket was a fun project to be part of. It's wonderful being able to celebrate another icon of British design!" - Sir Paul Smith Size Medium

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 A brand loved by subcultures, actors, poets and musicians, Baracuta's take on the Liddesdale is inspired by music and Wigan's Northern Soul movement.  An all -over bespoke and commemorative patch series on both the outer and inner of the garment brings a strong and bold identity to the quilt's simple construction, creating a bold celebration of the energy and spirit, music brings into our lives. "Music has always played a significant role within Baracuta as it is a brand that has always been adopted by subcultures and youth movements. When we think of music, the first sound that encapsulates the essence of Baracuta is undoubtedly Northern Soul, seen as a bridge between America and the UK. So, we revisited all the symbols and colours that characterised this sound and lifestyle and reinterpreted them uniquely while staying true to their historical roots." It was an honor to be part of this project with Barbour, and we are proud to have contributed as a brand to this icon of the fashion world." Luigi Bucci, Baracuta Size Large

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 David Gandy, model and founder of David Gandy Wellwear, has created a driving jacket inspired by the tonneau; a protective cover that fits over the open cockpit of his 1954 Jaguar XK120. David's jacket takes the functionality of the tonneau concept and reimagines it into a stylish cape effect coat. A tonneau 'cape' is layered over a liner jacket to create the ultimate driving jacket. The design is perfect for those days when you're driving with the sun shining, the roof down, the wind in your face and the open road ahead of you. "When tasked with a design for Barbour's iconic Liddesdale Jacket I based it entirely on uniqueness; I wanted a truly one-of-a-kind design that I had never seen before. The idea came when I was unclipping the tonneau (the protective cover) off of my classic 1954 Jaguar XK120. When driving you are open to the elements and the tonneau is stored away. So I thought about a versatile jacket design whereby you could simply fasten a protective cover, or cloak, over the inner Barbour you are already wearing when you are driving to protect yourself from the elements. Then when you stop driving, you unfasten the cloak in the same moment you reattach the tonneau to the car." Size Medium

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
material: quilted fabric, red fabric, layered skirt, wide collar
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 Serbian born Roksanda Ilincic is a luxury designer renowned for her bold use of colour and oversized silhouettes.  Her one off, bespoke quilt design is no less dramatic in a bold red with chest pockets and a belt that flatters the waist.  The quilt has an attached red layered skirt and wide collar to create a unique style demonstrating how this quilt style can be used as part of an outfit for a dinner party or a red-carpet occasion Size UK 10

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 Renowned for their design, craftsmanship, functionality and fun, Engineered Garments was founded by Japanese designer Daiki Suzuki in New York in 1999.  Their take on the bespoke Liddesdale is multi-faceted with plenty of zip and stud detail options.  In a clever garment construction with meticulous attention to detail, the Engineered Garments Liddesdale quilt can easily be worn across different looks to express the wearer's personal style.  The back and arm vents are bespoke and add a unique interpretation and elevation to the simplicity of the Liddesdale quilt.  An added touch is the inner day to night brand label reinforcing the versatility of the jacket to be styled and worn differently depending on the time of day. 'My journey with Barbour has been a long-standing one, spanning from my teenage years, through my twenties when I ventured into the world of fashion, and up to my current sixties. The first piece I ever purchased was the International Jacket in my mid-twenties. Since then, I've worn the basic Bedale, Beaufort, and Liddesdale jackets. I recall the excitement and joy I felt when I had the opportunity to collaborate multiple times starting from the Autumn Winter 2019 season. As a designer for Engineered Garments, I am known for drawing inspiration from vintage workwear, uniforms and the Ivy League style of America. However, I am also deeply influenced by the designer brands of the 1980s from Japan, Paris, London, and New York.  I decided to take a slightly experimental approach, heavily incorporating zippers, aiming to transform the basic design into something entirely different. As a result, the design that emerged truly resembles a transformer; the original basic design remains intact but through the wearer's ideas and ingenuity, various different looks can be achieved. Depending on the wearer's mood, the jacket can display different personalities, akin to day and night.  This unconventional design demands creativity from the wearer, making it an intriguing and demanding design unlike any other." Daiki Suzuki, Engineered Garments Size Medium

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 'Hug in a Jacket' Presenter, farmer, singer, songwriter and member of the band JLS, JB Gill has been a long-time friend of Barbour.  With a nod to his farming interests, JB's Liddesdale and gilet have plenty of country features with large shoulder and elbow patches. The stand out feature on this quilt is the large hand warmer pockets – not only will they keep your hands warm but they're big enough to share with friends – it's like a hug in a jacket! "My Re-loved Liddesdale and Gilet is all about comfort and love - It effortlessly bridges the gap between countryside and city. My inspiration for the hand warmer pockets was to take the warmth and comfort associated with a quilt and share it with a loved one. Whether it's a child embracing a parent from behind or a wife embracing their partner from the front, my Liddesdale is always able to give the perfect hug, whatever the circumstance." J.B Gill Included in lot: jacket and gilet Jacket Size Medium, Gilet Size Large

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 TV presenter, writer, adventurer and long-time friend of Barbour, Ben Fogle loves to spend time in the outdoors, exploring nature and everything it has to offer.  His take on the Liddesdale is inspired by the Boy Scouts and the outdoor skills they learn from fire building and wilderness survival to outdoor cooking and camping by the fire.  Ben's Liddesdale quilt is covered in authentic Boy Scout badges and comes with an accompanying bag to celebrate those who learn new skills and become confident in their ability to succeed no matter what the challenge. 'I loved working with Barbour on this fun jacket that is everything I hoped it would be.' Ben Fogle Included in lot: jacket and bag Size Medium

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 Stylist, fashion consultant and founder of Reluxe, Clare Richardson has created a longer length Liddesdale with a slightly longer back and soft curved edges with a small side split.  Underneath the outer quilt is a vintage denim jacket to create a second layer.  Stylish and on trend, this is a feminine take on the Liddesdale quilt Included in lot: jacket and gilet. Size UK 10-12

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 In a celebration of British style and the joy of the journey, the bespoke Barbour x Brompton Liddesdale pays homage to the bike. A lightweight Liddesdale bike poncho, this jacket covers not only the cyclist but also the bike, allowing ease of movement when cycling. Two large pockets on the poncho are great for essentials and there's a quilted storage bag to fold the jacket into when not in use.  Like the Brompton bike, it's a jacket you can take anywhere. 'Brompton exists to create urban freedom for happier lives. And we certainly like to move around on a bike with style. Our collaboration history with Barbour goes back a few editions of bicycles and accessories but this 30th anniversary unique re-design of the Liddesdale jacket fills us with joy to be able to join in the Barbour celebrations and once again team up to re-imagine our iconic products'. Marta Gut, Brompton Included in lot: jacket and bag. One Size

title: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024
material: nylon, corduroy, wool, deadstock Barbour tartan
description: Re-loved Quilted Liddesdale Jacket, Autumn 2024 With his British born Chinese heritage, stylist and Creative Director Karlmond Tang loves to create a unique narrative for the brands that he works with. For his take on the bespoke Liddesdale, he has designed a stylish reversible quilt. One side is an everyday functional field jacket that adheres to the core principles of the Liddesdale with additional chest pockets and side pockets.  Reverse it and you have a bold wool diamond check with simple side pockets.  It's a stylised twist on an icon that can easily be thrown on, whatever the occasion. "Being provided the opportunity to create a one-off of such an iconic British jacket was such a privilege. I wanted to keep all the DNA of the jacket intact as much as possible, which meant keeping the diamond quilt, the corduroy collar and its purpose as an easy-going, throw-on jacket. The twist would be creating something entirely new but recognisable. I thought of alternate shapes where nylon really sings and that led me to the bomber jacket. By cropping it, repurposing excess corduroy for the waist and cuffs, and moving the existing pockets up, we create a stylised version of a very recognisable jacket. We took it one step further by adding a statement reverse layer, and rotated a deadstock Barbour tartan to mirror the diamond quilt, which also acts as an insulation layer. Stylistically I took inspiration from iconic jackets of the 90s, but more importantly was the utility from Barbour jackets in the 1940s." Karlmond Tang Size Medium
